name: Noir
paragraphs: Create dramatic noir lighting effects with saturation controls, optically captured vignettes, flickering, Venetian patterns, and more using Noir.

Click the Choose a Preset... button to see an animated preview of all available presets. Double-click any preset to apply it. Once a preset is selected, you will see its name highlighted within the Vignette Preset drop-down menu below. Presets can also be applied directly from this Vignette Preset menu.
The images below illustrate how Noir changes a portrait with the Venetian preset's default values.
As with all other Universe tools, you can modify or create a Noir look and then save it under its own name by pressing the Save Preset... button.
